title: Morgenthau
medium: Glass, metal, lead, resin, gauze, gold leave, sand, terracotta and acrylic

said.q: The title of the sculpture alludes to the plan developed by the American Minister Henry Morgenthau at the end of the Second World War, aiming to starve Germany, guilty of genocide. In the big vitrine, a metallic snake (symbol and universal metaphor of evil and transformation) creeps into the ashes where stale and dry ears of wheat grow.
